text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thought Mejiro McQueen would return
to her
dorm after training today, but
strangely enough,
she's returned here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I need to continue building up
my
strength. Please, will you extend
today's training
session?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...On my way back, I happened upon
Ryan, who
said she was on her way to
begin training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I cannot allow myself to rest knowing
she's out
there putting in more work.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My aim is to always maintain a
magnificent lead. I
cannot afford to fall
behind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I'm glad you
understand how
I feel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Keep a steady eye on me. I won't try to
do the
impossible, but I will try to do my
best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Within reasonable limits, Mejiro
McQueen and I
continue with our
training for the day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
One might say I'm overworking myself,
but it
would be more of a waste to
ignore this current
surge of energy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, perhaps I have lost a bit of my
composure.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I would further lose the path forward if I
cannot
practice self-discipline. Dignity is
one of the core tenets of the Mejiro
family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen heeds my concern and
returns to
her dorm.
